blocks.text: Translation, yaani protein synthesis (protein banana), mein mRNA transcript mein maujood maloomat se amino acids ki tarteeb (sequence) tay hoti hai aur aik polypeptide banta hai.

blocks.title: Aage kya hai
blocks.text: Aage translation in hisson mein parhenge: pehle amino acids ki activation (har amino acid apne tRNA se jurta hai), phir initiation (ribosome, mRNA aur pehla tRNA ikatthe hote hain), elongation (har codon par aik amino acid jurta hai) aur termination (stop codon par zanjeer chhoot jati hai).

blocks.prompt: Translation kya banata hai, aur kis ki maloomat se?
blocks.explanation: Polypeptide (protein), mRNA ke codons ki tarteeb ke mutabiq.

items: Translation: mRNA ki maloomat se amino acids ki tarteeb tay ho kar polypeptide banta hai.
